result.topic_en:
Page of calculations, mostly written upside down, on representing a solution u of a heat-conduction-type equation through an integral of the error function $\int e^{-yy}dy$ against $\varphi'(t)$, using a power-series ansatz $\varphi t=\sum a_m t^m$ to satisfy a boundary condition $\partial u/\partial x-
u u+a=0$.
result.transcription:
Riemann 13

[upside-down part, read in natural orientation:]

$u_2 = \int_\infty^{\frac{x}{2\alpha\sqrt{t-\tau}}} e^{-yy}\,\partial y = v_2 + \Pi\tfrac12$ [?] \quad $x=0$ [?] \quad $\int_0^{\frac{x}{2\alpha\sqrt{s}}} e^{-xxyy}\,\partial y = \frac{x}{2\alpha\sqrt{s}}$ [?]

$u = \int_0^t v_2\, \varphi' t\, \partial t + \Pi\tfrac12\, \varphi t$ \quad $v_0 = u_0 = \Pi\tfrac12\,\varphi t$ [?]

$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = +\frac{\sqrt t}{2\alpha}\varphi 0 + \int_0^t \frac{\sqrt{s}}{2\alpha}\, \varphi'(t-s)\,\partial s$ [?]

$-\int_0^t \frac{\alpha\sqrt s}{1}\,\varphi''(t-s)\, s\,\partial s$ [?]

$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} - \nu u + a = 0$

$\varphi t = \sum a_m t^m$

$-\nu u = \sum -\nu\, a_m t^m$

$\frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = +\frac{\sqrt t}{2\alpha}\varphi 0 + \int_0^1 \frac{\partial y}{2\alpha\sqrt y}\sum m\, a_m t^{m-\frac12}(1-y)^{m-1} - \int_0^1 \frac{y\,\partial y}{\alpha\sqrt y}\sum m(m-1)\, a_m t^{m-\frac12}(1-y)^{m-2}$ [?]

$\int_0^1 y^{\alpha}(1-y)^{\beta}\,\partial y = \frac{\Pi\alpha\,\Pi\beta}{\Pi(\alpha+\beta+1)}$ \quad $+\left(\frac{1}{2\alpha}\, a_m\, \frac{\Pi(-\frac12)\,\Pi m}{\Pi(m-\frac12)} [-\frac{\Pi m}{\Pi\frac12}-] \right) t^{m-\frac12}$ [?]

$\frac{\sqrt t}{2\alpha}\varphi 0 - \sum \frac{\Pi\frac12\,\Pi m}{\Pi(m-\frac12)}\frac{a_m}{\alpha}\, t^{m-\frac12} - \sum \nu\, a_m t^m + a = 0$

$\Delta = \int_\infty^0 e^{-\frac z2} z^{\frac12}\,\partial z = \Pi\tfrac12$ [?]

$\frac{\Pi\frac12\,\Pi m}{\Pi(m-\frac12)\,\alpha}\, a_{m+\frac12} + \nu\, a_m\, (\Pi\tfrac12) = 0$ [?]

$\frac{\Pi m}{\Pi(m+\frac12)}\left(\frac{\nu}{\alpha}\right) a_{m+\frac12} = a_m$ \quad $a_m\,\Pi m\left(-\frac{\nu}{\alpha}\right)^{2m} = c$ [?]

$\varphi t = \sum \frac{c}{\Pi m}\left(-\frac{\nu}{\alpha}\right)^{2m} t^m$

$= \sum \frac{c}{\Pi\frac m2}\left(-\frac{\nu}{\alpha}\right)^{m} t^{\frac m2}$

$\varphi' t = \sum \frac{c}{\Pi(\frac m2 -1)}\left(-\frac{\nu}{\alpha}\right)^{m} t^{(\frac m2 -1)}$

$\varphi 0 = c\left(-\frac{\nu}{\alpha}\right)^2 \ldots - c\left(\frac{\nu}{\alpha}\right)^2 \frac{\alpha}{\nu}$ [?]

$e^{\frac{\nu\nu}{\alpha\alpha}t} - c\left(\frac{\nu}{\alpha}\right)^2 \frac{\alpha}{\nu} + t^{\frac12}$ [?]

$v_t = \int_0^{\frac{x}{2\alpha\sqrt{t-\tau}}} e^{-yy}\,\partial y$ \quad $\tau = t - \frac{xx}{4\alpha\alpha z}$ \quad $z = \frac{xx}{4\alpha\alpha(t-\tau)}$

$z = 0$ \quad $z = \frac{t}{4t}$ [?]

$u = \int_0^t e^{-\frac{xx}{4\alpha\alpha\tau}}\varphi' \ldots\,\partial\tau + \Pi\tfrac12\,\varphi t$ [?]

$= \Pi\tfrac12\,\varphi t - \frac{xx}{4\alpha\alpha}(\varphi' t\, v_t)_0 + \frac{xx}{4\alpha\alpha}\int_0^t \varphi'' t\,\partial t\, v_t$ [?]

$= \Pi\tfrac12\,\varphi t + \frac{x\nu}{\alpha\alpha}\varphi' t\, \Pi\tfrac12 + \frac{xx\nu}{4\alpha\alpha}\varphi'' \ldots$ [?]

[left column:]
$-2\left[\frac{1}{t}\left(e^{-\frac{1}{4t}} - 1\right)\right]_\infty^0 - \int_\infty^0 \partial t\, e^{-\frac{1}{4t}}\ldots$ [?]
[-$\partial t\left(1 - e^{-\frac{1}{4t}}\right)$-] $-2\left[\frac1t\left(\int_0^1 e^{-yy}\partial y - 1\right)\right]_\infty^0$ [?]

$\partial\frac{1}{t}$ [?]

$-2\int_\infty^0 \left(\int_0^{\frac{1}{2\sqrt t}} e^{-yy}\partial y - 1\right)\frac{\partial t}{t^2}$ [?]

$\left(\int_0^{\frac x2} e^{-yy}\partial y + 1\right) - 2\frac{\partial t}{t^2}$ [?]

$\int\int_0^{\frac{x}{2}} e^{-yy}\partial y + \sqrt{z}\,\partial z$ [?]

$\nu_0 = -4\,\Pi\tfrac12$

$\nu = [-\sum-] \sum \frac{(-1)^m \ldots}{\Pi m\,(2m-1)(2m+1)}$ [?]

$= \sum \frac{(-1)^m x^{2m+1}\ldots}{\Pi m\,(2m+1)}$ [?]

$= \sum \frac{(-1)^m y^{2m+1}}{\Pi m\,(2m+1)}$

$= \int_0^{\frac x2} e^{-yy}\partial y = \int \sum \frac{(-yy)^m}{\Pi m}\partial y$

methods.what: Ansatz: boundary condition of Robin type for the heat-equation solution
Power-series ansatz for the boundary function
Beta integral expressed via Gauss's Pi function
Recurrence for the coefficients obtained by comparing powers of t
Error-function integral as solution kernel, with substitution
Duhamel-type representation of u via integration by parts
